statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial evaluation for sick sinus syndrome
A mobile cardiac telemetry study, CPT 93229, is ordered
The study is for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The purpose is to characterize the correlation between symptomatic events and potential arrhythmic activity
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The submitted materials do not align with the records currently maintained in the insurer's system
